impact: Another tariff-refund-flattered retail beat; housing-linked spending is still soft, which matters little for his holdings beyond the broader read that consumer demand is holding up while the Fed leans hawkish.
source: Seeking Alpha / Globe and Mail / Finwire
summary: Lowe's fiscal Q3 comparable sales rose 1.8%, helped by a 17.4% jump in online sales and solid pro and home services demand, and adjusted EPS of $3.10 beat the $2.88 estimate, with tariff refunds of nearly $250M adding 34 cents. It raised its full-year comp outlook to up 0.5% from flat but kept its $12.25 EPS target. Shares fell about 2% to 4% premarket.
title: Lowe's beats with comps up 1.8%, lifts sales outlook; shares slip premarket
